title: Profiles: first start makes Default, a new profile never sticks on Loading
covers: initialProfile Default, profile switch, session tabs and runs reload
context: On the first start Archipelia creates a profile named Default and opens Home, with no question. After a switch, the runs and the open sessions reload, so the idle main window, the Sessions screen, History and Home all load. The test hides your profiles for a moment, so put them back at the end.
changed: stores reload on a profile switch

setup.label: state
setup.text: Close Archipelia. In .user-data\Data of the bundle-4 worktree rename the folder profiles to profiles-keep and the file app.json to app-keep.json. Leave the engine folder alone.

setup.label: restore
setup.text: At the end close Archipelia, delete the new profiles folder and app.json, and rename the two keep items back. Until then your own sessions and presets are hidden.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: The engine folder stays, so the engine is still ready.

steps: Launch with the command of this test. No screen asks you to pick or create a profile. The app opens on Home. If the tour opens by itself, press Skip.
Open the menu, then Profiles (just above About). The title reads Pick a profile, or create another. One profile named Default is listed and selected.
Press New profile, type Second in the box Profile name and confirm. The app switches to Second and the Profiles screen closes. If the tour opens again, press Skip.
Open Sessions: the list reads No session yet. New session builds one. and shows no spinner that stays. Open History: it reads No run yet. Run a session to start one.
Press Escape until the Multiworld window closes. The main window reads No session is open. Run a session to open it here. Wait ten seconds: it never stays on Loading open sessions with a spinner.
Press Esc to open the Multiworld window again. Home loads its title and setup checklist, with no spinner that stays.
Open the menu, Profiles, and press Default. The app switches back. Repeat steps 4 to 6 quickly: everything loads again each time.
Close Archipelia, delete the new profiles folder and app.json, rename profiles-keep and app-keep.json back, and launch again. Your own profiles are back.
pass: A first start creates the profile Default and opens Home, with no profile question.
A new profile switches at once, and Sessions, History, the idle main window and Home all load.
Switching back to Default loads everything again. Your own profiles are back after the restore.
fail: A screen asks you to create or pick a profile on the first start.
After New profile the idle window, Sessions or History stays on a spinner.
The profile Default is missing, or the switch needs a restart to show the data.
notes: If you do not want to hide your profiles, skip steps 1 and 8 and run only steps 3 to 7 with a new profile named Second. The Default part is then not checked.
The tour may open for a new profile; the Welcome tour test covers the tour.
Where profiles live may differ from the setup line. If a first start still lists your old profiles, say so in your note and what the Data folder holds.
